context: An isothermal reaction in a stirred tank. The rate was measured at many times and concentrations by repeated experiments. Reliable information from a colleague who knows this system (it is correct): the law is a sum of 3 terms. Each term is a constant times one factor, or a constant times a product of two factors that depend on different inputs.

target.name: dA_dt
target.meaning: rate of change of the concentration of species A

inputs.name: t
inputs.meaning: time since the start of the experiment
